authorization: User explicitly requested changing success criteria to the older repository after comparison of computational makeability and strict closure.
component_success: Exact identity is positively vendor-listed, or at least one complete target-bound computational route has every terminal leaf positively vendor-listed.
legacy_implementation_corrections: Enforce declared snapshot expiry; never silently reuse stale observations.
Bind terminal leaves to one actual complete route rather than unioning alternative paths.
Retain all route alternatives, all request occurrences and unknown/error states.
Use actual strict-qualified evidence as a valid stronger basis, not a bare historical success flag.
product_success: Exact L1 and all declared required component branches successful. Preserve every request in the denominator.

reporting.numeric_threshold_note: User changed criterion, not a numeric threshold; existing L1 >=90% per family and independent quality/validation requirements remain.

route_bases.forward_applied: Recorded published/registry transform chain reproduces target among products; uniqueness and substrate scope are separate attributes.
route_bases.planner_solved: Complete target-bound planner path; independent forward verification and exact-substrate source evidence not required for primary makeability.
